resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]if Statements[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Ok so our Boolean comparison has figured out if our statement is true or false, now what?

Well one thing you can do is use [b]if [/b]statements to run code based on a certain condition, say, if the Boolean evaluates to [b]True[/b].

With [b]If statements[/b], if the condition evaluates to [b]True[/b], the statements are carried out. Otherwise, they aren't carried out. 

An [b]if statement[/b] looks like this:[code format="raw" ][b]if[/b] condition:
   statements[/code]
[note]Python uses [b]indentation [/b](that empty space at the beginning of a line) to delimit blocks of code. Depending on the program's logic, indentation can be mandatory. As you can see, the statements in the [b]if [/b]should be indented.[/note]

resolved.title: if 语句
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]if Statements[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Ok, but when is life ever that simple? Sometimes we’ll have to perform more complex checks. But that’s no problem, because [b]if [/b]statements can be nested, one inside the other.

This means that the inner [b]if[/b] statement is the statement part of the outer one. This is one way to see whether multiple conditions are satisfied.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="3907"]num = 12
[b]if[/b] num > 5:
   print("Bigger than 5")
   [b]if[/b] num <= 47:
      print("Between 5 and 47")[/code]
[note]Indentation is used to define the level of nesting.[/note]
[s0l0!-coach id="1034" name="Pure Gold" xp="10" description="In order to make a gold purity checker you should output 'Accepted' only if it corresponds to 22 or 24K." imageUrl="/content/assets/fbf4383f92a3bd1d06f6.png" button="Start" color="366D9B"]Practice what you've learned.[/s0l0!-coach]

content.title: if语句

resolved.title: 判断黄金纯度
resolved.problem_statement_md:
用python判断黄金的纯度，我们只接受22K或24K黄金。

22K金中有91.7%以上的黄金(注意大于)，而24K对应的是99.9%及以上的纯度。

给出黄金纯度的百分比作为输入，如果它对应于22或24K，输出"已接受"
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]if Statement[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You’re making a gold purity checker, that should accept only 22K or 24K gold. Only the good stuff!

22K gold has 91.7% or more gold in it, while 24K corresponds to 99.9% and above purity.

Given the % of gold purity as input, you should output "Accepted" only if it corresponds to 22 or 24K.

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
93.4

[b]Sample Output:[/b]
Accepted 

[note]Do not output anything if the gold corresponds to lower purity levels.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 如果黄金对应的是较低的纯度，则不要输出任何东西。
